en.t: Diocletian is chosen as Roman emperor
en.s: The Roman emperor was the ruler of the Roman Empire, starting with the granting of the title augustus to Octavian in 27 BC. The title of imperator, originally a military honorific, was usually used alongside caesar, originally a cognomen. When a given Roman is described as becoming emperor in English, it generally reflects his accession as augustus, and later as basileus.

zh.t: 戴克里先被推举为罗马皇帝
zh.s: 罗马皇帝是罗马帝国的统治者，这一称号始于公元前27年屋大维获授“奥古斯都”称号。“英白拉多”原是军事荣誉称号，通常与“凯撒”并用；“凯撒”最初是一个家族名。英语中说某位罗马人成为皇帝，通常指其即位为奥古斯都，后来则称为巴西琉斯。

en.t: The Peace of Cremona ends the war between the Republic of Venice and the Duchy of Milan, after the victorious Venetian enterprise of military engineering of the Galeas per montes
en.s: The Republic of Venice, officially the Most Serene Republic of Venice and traditionally known as La Serenissima, was a maritime republic with its capital in Venice, on the northeastern coast of Italy. Founded, according to tradition, in 697 by Paolo Lucio Anafesto, over the course of its 1,100 years of history it established itself as one of the major European commercial and naval powers.

zh.t: 《克雷莫纳和约》结束威尼斯共和国与米兰公国之间的战争，此前威尼斯成功实施“翻山运炮”军事工程行动
zh.s: 威尼斯共和国正式名称为最尊贵的威尼斯共和国，传统上称为“Serenissima”。这是一个以威尼斯为首都的海上共和国，位于意大利东北海岸。据传它于697年由保罗·卢基奥·阿纳费斯托建立，在长达1100年的历史中逐渐成为欧洲主要的商业和海军强国之一。

en.s: The Second War of Kappel (German: Zweiter Kappelerkrieg) was an armed conflict in 1531 between the Catholic and the Protestant cantons of the Old Swiss Confederacy during the Reformation in Switzerland.

en.s: The Battle of Craibstone was fought on 20 November 1571 between Clan Gordon and the Clan Forbes on an area that has now been constructed over, found in central Aberdeen, Scotland. It was part of the Marian civil war in which the Clan Forbes supported the King and Clan Gordon supported the Queen. So called due to its proximity to Craibstone Croft, the battle was won by the Gordons who forced the Forbes into retreat in approximately one hour with the loss of sixty men.

zh.s: 1571年11月20日，戈登氏族与福布斯氏族在苏格兰阿伯丁市中心一处如今已被建筑覆盖的地方交战。这是马里内战的一部分，福布斯氏族支持国王，戈登氏族支持王后。战场因靠近克雷布斯通农场而得名。戈登氏族获胜，约一小时后迫使福布斯氏族撤退，战斗造成60人死亡。

en.s: The Battle of Totenhöhe took place on 20 November 1646 during the Thirty Years' War, in the northwestern part of the town of Totenhöhe in Upper Hesse between Imperial and Hesse-Darmstadt troops on one side, and a Hesse-Kassel-Swedish army on the other. The battle ended in victory for Hesse-Kassel and Sweden.

zh.s: 1646年11月20日，三十年战争期间，托滕赫厄西北部发生战斗，交战双方分别是帝国军和黑森-达姆施塔特军，以及黑森-卡塞尔与瑞典联军。黑森-卡塞尔和瑞典获胜。

en.s: The Wincanton Skirmish took place on 20 November 1688 in Wincanton, Somerset during the 1688 invasion of England. A small cavalry patrol of the English Army under Patrick Sarsfield clashed with a detachment of the Dutch States Army's Scots Brigade in one of only two minor battles fought in England during the Glorious Revolution.

zh.s: 1688年11月20日，英国发生光荣革命入侵期间，萨默塞特郡温坎顿爆发小规模冲突。帕特里克·萨斯菲尔德率领的一支英国陆军小型骑兵巡逻队，与荷兰共和国军队苏格兰旅的一支分队交战。这是光荣革命期间英格兰境内仅有的两场小规模战斗之一。

en.s: The Russo-Ottoman War of 1710–1713, also known as the Pruth River Campaign, was a brief military conflict between the Tsardom of Russia and the Ottoman Empire. The main battle took place during 18–22 July 1711 in the basin of the Pruth river near Stănilești after Tsar Peter I entered the Ottoman vassal Principality of Moldavia, following the Ottoman Empire's declaration of war on Russia.

zh.s: 1710—1713年俄奥斯曼战争又称普鲁特河战役，是俄罗斯沙皇国与奥斯曼帝国之间的一场短暂军事冲突。主要战斗于1711年7月18日至22日在斯特讷莱什蒂附近的普鲁特河流域展开。此前奥斯曼帝国向俄罗斯宣战，沙皇彼得一世随后进入奥斯曼属国摩尔达维亚公国。

en.s: The Battle of Porto Bello (also known as the Battle of Portobello) was a 1739 battle between a Royal Navy squadron aiming to capture the settlement of Portobelo in Panama, and its Spanish defenders. It took place during the War of the Austrian Succession, in the early stages of the war sometimes known as the War of Jenkins' Ear. The battle resulted in a popularly acclaimed British victory.

zh.s: 1739年波托韦洛战役也称波托贝洛战役，是奥地利王位继承战争期间的一场战斗。英国皇家海军舰队试图攻占巴拿马的波托韦洛，西班牙守军予以抵抗。这场战斗被广泛视为英国取得的胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Maxen (20 November 1759) was a battle at Maxen, Saxony in present-day Germany during the Seven Years' War. It resulted in surrender of a Prussian corps. The Prussian corps of 14,000 men, commanded by Friedrich August von Finck (one of Frederick the Great's generals), was sent to threaten lines of communication between the Austrian army at Dresden and Bohemia.

zh.s: 1759年11月20日，七年战争期间，萨克森州马克森发生战斗，普鲁士军团被迫投降。腓特烈大帝的将领之一弗里德里希·奥古斯特·冯·芬克率领这支由14,000人组成的普鲁士军团，前往威胁奥地利军队在德累斯顿与波希米亚之间的交通线。

en.s: The Battle of Quiberon Bay (known as the Bataille des Cardinaux by the French) was a decisive naval engagement during the Seven Years' War. It was fought on 20–21 November 1759 between the Royal Navy and the French Navy in Quiberon Bay, off the coast of France near Saint-Nazaire. The battle was the culmination of British efforts to eliminate French naval superiority, which could have given the French the ability to carry out their planned invasion of Great Britain.

zh.s: 基伯龙湾海战（法语称巴塔耶·德·卡尔迪诺）是七年战争期间一场具有决定性意义的海战，于1759年11月20日至21日在法国海军与英国皇家海军之间爆发，地点在法国海岸外、圣纳泽尔附近的基伯龙湾。英国希望削弱法国海军优势，以阻止法国利用海军优势实施入侵英国的计划。

en.t: American Revolutionary War: The Battle of Fort Lee saw the invasion of New Jersey by British and Hessian forces and the subsequent general retreat of the Continental Army
en.s: Fort Lee Historic Park is located atop a bluff of the Hudson Palisades overlooking Burdett's Landing, known as Mount Constitution, in Fort Lee, New Jersey, United States. The park was conceived as early as 1952. Native Americans appear to have lived in the area for thousands of years before the arrival of Europeans. The bluff was the site of George Washington's 1776 encampment opposite Fort Washington at the northern end of Manhattan.

zh.t: 美国独立战争：李堡战役中，英军和黑森军队入侵新泽西，随后大陆军全面撤退
zh.s: 李堡历史公园位于新泽西州李堡的一处悬崖顶上，可俯瞰哈德逊帕利塞兹的伯德特登陆点，亦称宪法山。公园早在1952年便开始规划。欧洲人到来前，原住民似乎已在当地生活数千年。1776年乔治·华盛顿曾在此处扎营，与曼哈顿北端的华盛顿堡隔河相望。

en.s: The Acton of 20 November 1779 was a minor naval engagement of the European theater of the Anglo-Spanish War that took place in the Atlantic. It was fought between a 50-gun Royal Naval ship against a Spanish navy 64-gun ship though armed en flute. On November 19, 1779, HMS Hussar of 28 guns, under Captain Elliot Salter, was in company with HMS Chatham of 50 guns. They were convoying trade from Lisbon back to England when they saw a two-decked ship standing out of the convoy, and at once gave chase.

zh.s: 1779年11月20日的阿克顿海战是英西战争期间欧洲战场的一场小规模海战，发生在大西洋。交战双方是一艘装备50门火炮的英国皇家海军舰艇和一艘装备64门火炮、改作运输用途的西班牙军舰。11月19日，装备28门火炮的英国皇家海军“胡萨尔”号由埃利奥特·索尔特上尉指挥，与装备50门火炮的“查塔姆”号同行。两舰护送商船从里斯本返回英国时，发现一艘双层甲板船驶离船队，随即追了上去。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Virginia on November 20, 1782. The incumbent governor of Virginia Benjamin Harrison V was re-elected. The election was conducted by the Virginia General Assembly in joint session. The House of Delegates met on November 19 to make nominations for governor and other offices, which the Senate accepted without amendment; the rule disqualifying votes for candidates other than those nominated was repealed prior to the balloting.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州于1782年11月20日举行州长选举，现任州长本杰明·哈里森五世再次当选。选举由弗吉尼亚州议会两院联席会议举行。众议院于11月19日提名州长及其他官员人选，参议院未作修改便予以接受；投票前，议会废除了不得投票给未获提名候选人的规定。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Virginia on November 20, 1794. The Democratic-Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates from Spotsylvania County Robert Brooke defeated the Federalist member of the Council of State James Wood. The Federalist incumbent governor of Virginia Henry Lee III was ineligible for re-election due to term limits established by the Constitution of Virginia.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州于1794年11月20日举行州长选举。弗吉尼亚州众议院斯波茨瓦尼亚县的民主共和党议员罗伯特·布鲁克击败了州政务委员会的联邦党议员詹姆斯·伍德。根据弗吉尼亚州宪法规定的任期限制，联邦党籍现任州长亨利·李三世不能竞选连任。

en.s: The Battle of the Black Mountain (also Capmany or Serra Negra or Del Roure or Montroig) was fought from 17 to 20 November 1794 between the army of the First French Republic and the allied armies of the Kingdom of Spain and the Kingdom of Portugal. The French, led by Jacques François Dugommier, defeated the Allies, who were commanded by Luis Firmín de Carvajal, Conde de la Unión.

zh.s: 黑山战役也称卡普马尼战役、塞拉内格拉战役、德尔鲁雷战役或蒙特罗伊格战役，于1794年11月17日至20日爆发。交战双方是法兰西第一共和国军队，以及西班牙王国和葡萄牙王国的联军。雅克-弗朗索瓦·迪戈米耶率领法军击败了由路易斯·费尔明·德·卡瓦哈尔、德拉乌尼翁伯爵指挥的联军。

en.s: On November 20, 1798, a pair of French Navy frigates, the L'insurgente and Volontaire, with some 80 guns in combined strength, captured an American 14-gun schooner, USS Retaliation. The ship was later recaptured on June 28, 1799, and the L'insurgente was captured the following month as well. The Retaliation was the only American warship captured during the war.

zh.s: 1798年11月20日，法国海军两艘护卫舰“起义者”号和“志愿者”号合计装备约80门火炮，俘获了一艘装备14门火炮的美国纵帆船“报复”号。1799年6月28日，“报复”号后来被美军夺回；次月，“起义者”号也被俘。“报复”号是这场战争中唯一被俘的美国军舰。

en.s: The 1802 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 20, 1802, in order to elect the Governor of North Carolina. Democratic-Republican candidate and former member of the U.S. House of Representatives from North Carolina's 3rd district John Baptista Ashe was elected by the North Carolina General Assembly against Federalist candidate and former member of the North Carolina House of Representatives William Polk and Democratic-Republican candidate Joseph Taylor.

zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于1802年11月20日举行州长选举。民主共和党候选人约翰·巴蒂斯塔·阿什曾任美国众议院北卡罗来纳州第三选区议员，他在选举中击败了联邦党候选人威廉·波尔克和民主共和党候选人约瑟夫·泰勒。选举由北卡罗来纳州议会举行。

en.s: The Battle of Lacolle River was fought on November 20, 1812, during the War of 1812. In this relatively short and fast battle, a very small garrison of Canadian militia, with the assistance of Kahnawake Mohawk warriors, defended a makeshift log guardhouse on the Montreal road at the bridge over the Lacolle River (present day village of Lacolle, Quebec). The American invasion force, prepared and led by Major General Henry Dearborn, captured the blockhouse in the early morning, possibly following a brief confrontation with the outnumbered defending forces.

zh.s: 1812年11月20日，拉科尔河战役在1812年战争期间爆发。这场战斗持续时间较短，加拿大民兵的一支小型守军在卡纳瓦克莫霍克战士协助下，守卫蒙特利尔通往拉科尔河桥上的临时木制岗楼，该地点位于今魁北克省拉科尔村。由迪尔伯恩少将率领并做好进攻准备的美军在清晨攻占了岗楼，可能是在与人数较少的守军短暂交战后得手。

en.s: The Treaty of Paris of 1815, also known as the Second Treaty of Paris, was signed on 20 November 1815, after the defeat and the second abdication of Napoleon Bonaparte. In February, Napoleon had escaped from his exile on Elba, entered Paris on 20 March and began the Hundred Days of his restored rule.

zh.s: 1815年11月20日，拿破仑·波拿巴战败并第二次退位后，双方签署了巴黎条约，也称第二次巴黎条约。当年2月，拿破仑从厄尔巴岛流放地逃出，3月20日进入巴黎，开始了复辟统治的百日王朝。

en.t: 1816 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: A presidential election was held in Rhode Island on November 20, 1816 as part of the 1816 United States presidential election. The Democratic-Republican ticket of U.S. Secretary of State James Monroe and Governor of New York Daniel D. Tompkins was elected unopposed. The Federalist Party failed to nominate a candidate. In the national election, Monroe easily defeated the senior U.S. senator from New York, Rufus King, who received 34 votes from unpledged electors despite not being a candidate.

zh.t: 1816年美国总统选举罗得岛州投票
zh.s: 1816年美国总统选举期间，罗得岛州于11月20日举行投票。民主共和党候选人、美国国务卿詹姆斯·门罗与纽约州州长丹尼尔·汤普金斯组成的搭档没有对手，当选。联邦党没有提名候选人。在全国选举中，门罗轻松击败纽约州资深联邦参议员鲁弗斯·金；金虽未参选，仍获得34张未承诺选举人票。

en.s: The 1848 Newfoundland general election was held on November 20, 1848 to elect members of the 4th General Assembly of Newfoundland in the Newfoundland Colony. The House of Assembly and the Legislative Council were restored as separate bodies following an experiment by Governor John Harvey which had amalgamated the two legislatures. The Liberal Party continued to maintain a majority of seats with a Conservative opposition.

en.s: General elections were held in Italy on 20 November 1870, with a second round of voting on 27 November. They were a snap election, called by Prime Minister Giovanni Lanza to take advantage by the Capture of Rome and to give parliamentary representation to the future capital of Italy. Only 530,018 men of a total population of around 26 million were entitled to vote. They were largely aristocrats representing rentiers from the north of the country, and held moderate political views including loyalty to the crown and low government spending.

zh.s: 意大利于1870年11月20日举行大选，第二轮投票于11月27日举行。这次提前选举由乔瓦尼·兰扎首相发起，目的是借罗马被占领之势，为意大利未来的首都争取议会代表权。当时意大利总人口约2600万，只有530,018名男性有投票权。他们大多是来自意大利北部、依靠租金收入的贵族，政治立场温和，支持君主制，主张政府减少开支。

en.s: The Battle of Hanoi was fought on 20 November 1873 between France and Đại Nam. A French expeditionary force composed of 140 sailors, 30 marines and 8 officers under the command of Navy Lieutenant Francis Garnier captured the provincial capital Hanoi, where they had been sent by France on a diplomatic mission, without superiors' orders.

zh.s: 1873年11月20日，法国与大南国爆发河内战役。由海军中尉弗朗西斯·加尼耶指挥的一支法国远征队包括140名水手、30名海军陆战队员和8名军官。他们奉法国之命执行外交任务，但未获上级授权，随后攻占了省会河内。

en.s: The 1897 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final was the 10th All-Ireland Final and the culmination of the 1897 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship, an inter-county hurling tournament for the top teams in Ireland. en.t: The French actress Sarah Bernhardt receives the press at the Savoy Hotel in New York at the outset of her first visit since 1896. She talked about her impending tour with a troupe of more than 50 performers and her plans to play the title role in Hamlet
en.s: Sarah Bernhardt (French: [saʁa bɛʁnɑʁt]; born Henriette-Rosine Bernard; 22 October 1844 – 26 March 1923) was a French stage actress who starred in some of the most popular French plays of the late 19th and early 20th centuries, including La Dame aux Camélias by Alexandre Dumas fils, Ruy Blas by Victor Hugo, Fédora and La Tosca by Victorien Sardou, and L'Aiglon by Edmond Rostand.

zh.t: 法国女演员莎拉·伯恩哈特自1896年以来首次到访纽约，在萨沃伊酒店会见记者，谈及由50多名演员组成的剧团即将展开巡演，以及她出演《哈姆雷特》主角的计划
zh.s: 莎拉·伯恩哈特（法语：saʁa bɛʁnɑʁt；原名亨丽埃特-罗辛·贝尔纳；1844年10月22日—1923年3月26日）是法国舞台剧女演员，主演了19世纪末和20世纪初一些最受欢迎的法国戏剧，包括小仲马的《茶花女》、维克多·雨果的《吕伊·布拉斯》、维克托里安·萨尔杜的《费多拉》和《托斯卡》，以及埃德蒙·罗斯丹的《小鹰》。

en.s: The Mexican Revolution (Spanish: Revolución mexicana) was an extended sequence of armed regional conflicts in Mexico from 20 November 1910 to 1 December 1920. It has been called "the defining event of modern Mexican history". It saw the destruction of the Federal Army, its replacement by a revolutionary army, and the transformation of Mexican culture and government. The northern Constitutionalist faction prevailed on the battlefield and drafted the present-day Constitution of Mexico, which aimed to create a strong central government. Revolutionary generals held power from 1920 to 1940.

zh.s: 墨西哥革命（西班牙语：Revolución mexicana）是墨西哥一系列持续时间较长的地区性武装冲突，从1910年11月20日持续到1920年12月1日。它被称为“现代墨西哥史上的决定性事件”。革命摧毁了联邦军队，随后联邦军队被革命军取代，墨西哥的文化和政府也因此发生变化。北方立宪派在战场上获胜，并起草了现行的墨西哥宪法，目标是建立强大的中央政府。革命将领从1920年至1940年掌握政权。

en.s: The Mexican Border War was a series of military engagements between the United States military and several Mexican factions in the Mexican–American border region of North America during the Mexican Revolution. From the beginning of the Mexican Revolution in 1910, the United States Army was stationed in force along the border and, on several occasions, fought with Mexican rebels or regular federal troops.

en.t: First World War: The Battle of Cambrai began with British forces having initial success over Germany's Hindenburg Line
en.s: The Battle of Cambrai (Battle of Cambrai, 1917, First Battle of Cambrai and Schlacht von Cambrai) was a British attack in the First World War, followed by the biggest German counter-attack against the British Expeditionary Force (BEF) since 1914. The town of Cambrai, in the département of Nord, in France, was an important supply centre for the German Siegfriedstellung (known to the British as the Hindenburg Line) and capture of the town and the nearby Bourlon Ridge would threaten the rear of the German line to the north.

zh.t: 第一次世界大战：康布雷战役
zh.s: 康布雷战役（又称1917年康布雷战役、第一次康布雷战役；德语：Schlacht von Cambrai）是第一次世界大战期间英国发动的一次进攻。随后，德军对英国远征军发动了自1914年以来规模最大的一次反攻。法国北部省的康布雷镇是德军齐格菲防线（英军称兴登堡防线）的重要补给中心；夺取该镇及附近的布尔隆岭将威胁德军防线北段后方。

en.s: Ukraine is a country in Eastern Europe. It is the second-largest country in Europe after Russia, which borders it to the east and northeast. Ukraine also borders Belarus to the north; Poland and Slovakia to the west; Hungary, Romania and Moldova to the southwest; and the Black Sea and the Sea of Azov to the south and southeast. Kyiv is Ukraine's capital and largest city, followed by Kharkiv, Odesa, and Dnipro.

zh.s: 乌克兰是东欧国家，按面积计算是欧洲第二大国，仅次于俄罗斯，东邻俄罗斯，东北也与俄罗斯接壤。乌克兰北邻白俄罗斯，西接波兰和斯洛伐克，西南邻匈牙利、罗马尼亚和摩尔多瓦，南部和东南部濒临黑海与亚速海。首都和最大城市为基辅，其次是哈尔科夫、敖德萨和第聂伯罗。

en.s: The Wrekin by-election of November 1920 was held on 20 November 1920. The by-election was held due to the death of the incumbent Independent Parliamentary Group MP, Charles Palmer. It was won by the Independent Parliamentary Group candidate, 59-year old retired Major-General Sir Charles Townshend, who was against the current Unionist-Liberal coalition government and beat Charles Duncan, 55-year old Labour candidate and former MP.

zh.s: 雷金选区于1920年11月20日举行补选。此次补选因现任独立议会团议员查尔斯·帕尔默去世而举行。59岁的退役少将查尔斯·汤森德爵士代表独立议会团参选并获胜。他反对当时的统一党与自由党联合政府，击败了55岁的工党候选人、前议员查尔斯·邓肯。

en.s: The Albanian–Yugoslav border war of 1921 arose from disputes over the borders of the newly established Principality of Albania after the First Balkan War. Although the 1913 Treaty of London outlined general territorial terms for Albania, precise borders remained unresolved amid the chaos of World War I, the Paris Peace Conference, and the League of Nations' formation.

en.s: The 1920 Copa Aldao was the final match to decide the winner of the Copa Aldao, the sixth edition of the international competition organised by the Argentine and Uruguayan Associations together. The final was contested by the same teams than the previous edition, Uruguayan Nacional and Argentine Boca Juniors. In the match, played at Estadio Sportivo Barracas in Buenos Aires on November 20, 1921, Nacional beat Boca Juniors 2–1, winning its third (and last) Copa Aldao trophy.

zh.s: 1920年阿尔道杯决赛决定了第六届阿尔道杯的冠军归属。这项赛事由阿根廷和乌拉圭足协共同举办。决赛由上一届的两支球队交锋：乌拉圭民族队对阵阿根廷博卡青年队。比赛于1921年11月20日在布宜诺斯艾利斯的巴拉卡斯体育场举行，民族队以2比1获胜，第三次也是最后一次夺得阿尔道杯。

en.s: The 1932 Catalan regional election was held on 20 November 1932 to elect the first legislature of the Parliament of the autonomous region of Catalonia. It was the sole Catalan parliamentary election held during the Second Spanish Republic (1931-1939). Between 1939 and 1980 the Parliament, as the rest of the institutions of the Generalitat of Catalonia, remained in exile as a consequence of the Republican defeat in the Spanish Civil War, and there wasn't another election until 1980.

zh.s: 加泰罗尼亚于1932年11月20日举行地区选举，选出自治区议会首届议员。这是西班牙第二共和国时期（1931至1939年）唯一一次加泰罗尼亚议会选举。1939年西班牙内战结束后，议会和加泰罗尼亚自治区政府的其他机构流亡海外，直到1980年才再次举行选举。

en.s: The Second Prefectural Assembly Elections (Japanese: 第二囘州會議員選擧) were held on 20 November 1940 in Taiwan under Japanese rule. In this time, 82 seats from five prefectural assemblies were open for election.

en.s: Operation Stoneage or Operation Stone Age (16–20 November 1942) was an Allied convoy to the Mediterranean island of Malta in the Second World War. To disguise the destination of the ships, some took on their cargo at Port Sudan in the Red Sea. The four ships of Convoy MW 13 sailed from Alexandria on 16 November, escorted by cruisers, destroyers and round-the-clock air cover from captured airfields in Egypt and Cyrenaica (eastern Libya).

en.s: United States Marines landed on Betio, Tarawa Atoll, on November 20, 1943, opening the Battle of Tarawa against Japanese forces. Tarawa is in the Gilbert Islands, now part of Kiribati. The fighting continued through November 23.
en.n: First day of the November 20–23 battle; the marker identifies the battlefield in present-day Kiribati.

zh.t: 美军登陆塔拉瓦，塔拉瓦战役开始
zh.s: 1943年11月20日，美国海军陆战队登陆塔拉瓦环礁的贝蒂奥岛，与日军展开战斗，塔拉瓦战役由此开始。塔拉瓦位于吉尔伯特群岛，如今属于基里巴斯。战斗持续到11月23日。

en.s: Elections were held in the state of Western Australia on 20 November 1943 to elect all 50 members to the Legislative Assembly. The Labor Party, led by Premier John Willcock, won a fourth term in office against the Country and Nationalist parties, led by Opposition Leader Arthur Watts and Robert Ross McDonald respectively. The election took place in the midst of World War II, and as such, turnout was considerably down on the previous election.

zh.s: 西澳大利亚州于1943年11月20日举行选举，选出立法议会全部50名议员。由州长约翰·威尔科克领导的工党击败由反对党领袖亚瑟·瓦茨和罗伯特·罗斯·麦克唐纳分别领导的乡村党和民族主义党，第四次执政。由于选举在第二次世界大战期间举行，投票率明显低于上届。

en.s: The Nuremberg trials were international criminal trials held by France, the Soviet Union, the United Kingdom, and the United States against leaders of defeated Nazi Germany for plotting and carrying out invasions of several countries across Europe and committing atrocities against their citizens in the Second World War. Between 1939 and 1945, Nazi Germany invaded many countries across Europe, inflicting 27 million deaths in the Soviet Union alone.

en.t: Declaration of the Rights of the Child
en.s: The Declaration of the Rights of the Child, sometimes known as the Geneva Declaration of the Rights of the Child, is an international document promoting child rights, drafted by Eglantyne Jebb and adopted by the League of Nations in 1924, and adopted in an extended form by the United Nations in 1959.

en.s: The Farmington Mine disaster was an explosion that happened at approximately 5:30 a.m. on November 20, 1968, at the Consol No. 9 coal mine north of Farmington and Mannington, West Virginia, USA. The explosion was large enough to be felt in Fairmont, almost 12 miles away. At the time, 99 miners were inside. Over the course of the next few hours, 21 miners were able to escape the mine, but 78 were still trapped. All who were unable to escape perished; the bodies of 19 of the dead were never recovered.

zh.s: 1968年11月20日凌晨约5时30分，美国西弗吉尼亚州法明顿和曼宁顿以北的康索尔9号煤矿发生爆炸。爆炸威力很大，近12英里外的费尔蒙特也能感受到。当时矿井里有99名矿工。随后几小时内，21人逃出，另有78人仍被困。未能逃出的矿工全部遇难，其中19人的遗体始终未能找到。

en.s: The Occupation of Alcatraz (November 20, 1969 – June 11, 1971) was a 19-month long occupation of Alcatraz Island and its prison complex, then classified as abandoned surplus federal land, by 89 American Indians and their supporters. The occupation was led by Richard Oakes, LaNada Means, and others, while John Trudell served as spokesman. The group lived on the island together until the occupation was forcibly ended by the U.S. government.
en.n: This decision by LaNada Means to choose November 20, 1969, began the successful 19-month occupation of Alcatraz opening up hearts and minds to Native American issues and struggles throughout the country, a forerunner of the Red Power movement and the Self Determination Era.

zh.s: 恶魔岛占领事件从1969年11月20日持续到1971年6月11日。89名美国原住民及其支持者占领了恶魔岛及岛上的监狱设施，当时该处已被列为废弃的联邦剩余土地。理查德·奥克斯、拉纳达·米恩斯等人领导这次占领，约翰·特鲁德尔担任发言人。参与者共同住在岛上，直到美国政府强行结束占领。
zh.n: 拉纳达·米恩斯作出这一决定，选择于1969年11月20日开始占领恶魔岛。这次持续19个月的行动让全国更多人关注美国原住民的议题和斗争，并成为红色力量运动及自决时代的先声。

en.s: Lufthansa Flight 540 was a scheduled commercial flight for Lufthansa, serving the Frankfurt–Nairobi–Johannesburg route. On 20 November 1974, the Boeing 747-130 that was operating as Flight 540 was carrying 157 people (139 passengers and 18 crew members) crashed and caught fire shortly after taking off from Embakasi Airport in Nairobi, Kenya, for the last leg of the flight, resulting in the deaths of 54 passengers and 5 crew members.

zh.s: 汉莎航空540号班机是一趟定期商业航班，航线为法兰克福—内罗毕—约翰内斯堡。1974年11月20日，这架执行540号航班的波音747-130载有157人，包括139名乘客和18名机组人员。飞机从肯尼亚内罗毕恩巴卡西机场起飞，准备进行航程最后一段飞行，起飞后不久便坠毁并起火，54名乘客和5名机组人员遇难。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 20 November 1977. After Prime Minister Constantine Karamanlis called for early elections, his New Democracy party suffered a significant loss of power. However, Karamanlis managed to secure an absolute majority in the Parliament. The big surprise was the success of PASOK, whose socialistic rhetoric remained radical. Because of PASOK's success, the Centrists (Union of the Democratic Centre, ΕDIK, former Center Union - New Forces) led again by Georgios Mavros lost half of their power. As a result, Andreas Papandreou, PASOK's leader, became a prominent figure in Greek politics.

zh.s: 希腊于1977年11月20日举行议会选举。康斯坦丁·卡拉曼利斯总理提前举行选举后，他领导的新民主党明显失去支持，但仍保住了议会绝对多数。帕索克以激进的社会主义言论取得显著成绩，成为一大意外。帕索克的成功使乔治·马夫罗斯再次领导的中间派民主中心联盟（前身为中间联盟—新力量）支持率减半。此后，帕索克领导人安德烈亚斯·帕潘德里欧在希腊政坛上崭露头角。

en.s: The 1977 Season's Cup (Кубок сезона) was the first edition of Soviet Super Cup, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Soviet Top League and Soviet Cup competitions. The match was played at the Stadion Dinamo imeni Lenina, Tbilisi, on 20 November 1977, and contested by league winner Dinamo Kiev and cup winner Dinamo Moscow. Dinamo Moscow won it 1–0.

zh.s: 1977年苏联超级杯是首届苏联超级杯，由上赛季苏联顶级联赛和苏联杯冠军进行年度对决。比赛于1977年11月20日在第比利斯的列宁迪纳摩体育场举行，由联赛冠军基辅迪纳摩对阵杯赛冠军莫斯科迪纳摩。莫斯科迪纳摩以1比0获胜。

en.s: The 1978 Yukon general election was held on November 20, 1978, was the first conventional legislative election in the history of Canada's Yukon Territory. Prior elections were held to elect representatives to the Yukon Territorial Council, a non-partisan body that acted in an advisory role to the Commissioner of the Yukon.

en.s: The Grand Mosque seizure took place between 20 November and 4 December 1979 at the Grand Mosque of Mecca in Mecca, Saudi Arabia, the holiest site in Islam. The attack was carried out by up to 600 militants led by Juhayman al-Otaybi, a Saudi Islamist opposed to the monarchy, belonging to the Otaibah tribe.

zh.s: 1979年11月20日至12月4日，武装分子占领了沙特阿拉伯麦加的大清真寺。袭击由多达600名武装分子实施，领导者是反对沙特王室的沙特伊斯兰主义者朱海曼·奥泰比，他属于奥泰巴部族。大清真寺是伊斯兰教最神圣的场所。

en.t: Microsoft Windows 1.0, the first graphical personal computer operating environment developed by Microsoft, is released
en.s: Windows 1.0 is the first major release of Microsoft Windows, a family of graphical user shells and operating systems for personal computers developed by Microsoft. It was first released to manufacturing in the United States and the general public on November 20, 1985, while the European version was released as Windows 1.02 in May 1986.

zh.s: Windows 1.0是微软Windows系列图形用户界面和个人电脑操作系统的首个重要版本。该版本于1985年11月20日在美国首次交付制造，并向公众发布；欧洲版Windows 1.02则于1986年5月发布。

en.s: The Battle of Ernestinovo was a battle during the Croatian War of Independence fought on 20 November 1991. It was fought between Croatia, and SAO Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Syrmia which was supported by the Yugoslav People's Army (JNA). The JNA took Ernestinovo then the battle for Antunovac began.

zh.s: 埃尔内斯蒂诺沃战役是克罗地亚独立战争期间的一场战斗，于1991年11月20日爆发。交战双方是克罗地亚，以及得到南斯拉夫人民军支持的东斯拉沃尼亚、巴拉尼亚和西锡尔米亚塞尔维亚自治区军队。南斯拉夫人民军攻占埃尔内斯蒂诺沃后，安图诺瓦茨战役随即开始。

en.s: On November 20, 1991, an Azerbaijani Mil Mi-8 military helicopter, carrying a peacekeeping mission team consisting of 13 Azerbaijani government officials, two Russian and one Kazakhstani Ministry of Internal Affairs officials, three Azerbaijani journalists and three helicopter crew was shot down amidst heavy fighting near the village of Berdashen, also known as Karakend, in Nagorno-Karabakh. All 22 people (19 passengers and three crew) on board were killed in the crash.

zh.t: 1991年阿塞拜疆米-8直升机被击落事件
zh.s: 1991年11月20日，一架阿塞拜疆米-8军用直升机在纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫的别尔达申村附近激战中被击落。机上载有执行维和任务的人员，包括13名阿塞拜疆政府官员、2名俄罗斯内务部官员、1名哈萨克斯坦内务部官员、3名阿塞拜疆记者和3名机组人员。机上22人全部遇难，其中包括19名乘客和3名机组人员。

en.s: The 1992 Windsor Castle fire occurred on 20 November 1992 in Windsor Castle, the largest inhabited castle in the world and one of the official residences of Queen Elizabeth II. The castle suffered extensive damage in the fire and was fully repaired within the next few years at a cost of £36.5 million, in a project led by the conservation architects Donald Insall Associates. It led to the Queen paying tax on her income, and to Buckingham Palace, the Queen's other official residence, being opened to the public to help pay for the restoration work.

zh.s: 1992年11月20日，温莎城堡发生火灾。这座城堡是世界上最大的有人居住的城堡，也是伊丽莎白二世女王的官邸之一。火灾造成严重损毁，之后几年内完成全面修复，工程耗资3650万英镑，由Donald Insall Associates的文物保护建筑师主持。火灾促使女王开始为收入纳税，白金汉宫也向公众开放，以筹集修复费用。

en.s: BattleBowl was a one-time professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW). The show took place on November 20, 1993, at the Pensacola Civic Center in Pensacola, Florida. The event featured only the "BattleBowl Tournament", where the first round consisted of eight tag team matches where the teams were drawn at random in a "Lethal Lottery".

zh.s: BattleBowl是世界冠军摔角（WCW）仅举办过一次的职业摔角付费赛事，于1993年11月20日在佛罗里达州彭萨科拉的彭萨科拉市民中心举行。赛事只有一项内容，即“BattleBowl锦标赛”：首轮是8场随机配对的双打赛，参赛队伍通过名为“致命抽签”的方式决定。

en.s: Avioimpex Flight 110 was a scheduled international passenger flight operated by Avioimpex that crashed on 20 November 1993 while flying from Geneva to Skopje. Before the disaster, Flight 110 had deviated from Skopje International Airport to Ohrid Airport due to a blizzard in the Macedonian capital. The plane, a Yakovlev Yak-42, was carrying 108 passengers and eight crew, and crashed about 7 kilometres (4.3 mi; 3.8 nmi) east of Ohrid Airport.

zh.t: 阿维奥因佩克斯110号班机空难
zh.s: 阿维奥因佩克斯110号班机是一趟定期国际客运航班，于1993年11月20日从日内瓦飞往斯科普里途中坠毁。事故发生前，因马其顿首都暴风雪，航班从斯科普里国际机场改降奥赫里德机场。这架雅克-42飞机载有108名乘客和8名机组人员，在奥赫里德机场以东约7公里处坠毁。

en.s: The Big Egg Wrestling Universe was a professional wrestling event held at Tokyo Dome in Tokyo, Japan on November 20, 1994 and attended by 32,500 fans. However, some sources claim the event was attended by over 42,000 fans. The event generated approximately $4 million in revenue from ticket sales, as well as $1.6 million in merchandise sales. The event featured representatives from joshi promotions All Japan Women's Pro-Wrestling (AJW), GAEA Japan, JWP Joshi Puroresu, and Ladies Legend Pro-Wrestling (LLPW), as well as puroresu promotion Frontier Martial-Arts Wrestling (which had a large women's division at the time).

zh.s: Big Egg摔角盛典于1994年11月20日在日本东京巨蛋举行，吸引了32,500名观众；部分来源称观众超过42,000人。门票收入约400万美元，商品销售额约160万美元。全日本女子职业摔角、GAEA Japan、JWP女子职业摔角和Ladies Legend职业摔角等女子摔角团体，以及当时拥有大型女子部门的Frontier Martial-Arts Wrestling，都派出选手参赛。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held on November 20, 1994 to elect the Governor of Okinawa (沖縄県, Okinawa-ken), which is the southernmost and westernmost prefecture of Japan. Incumbent Masahide Ōta was re-elected for a second term as governor. In 1994, the Okinawans' Attitude Survey conducted by the cabinet office found that public perceptions of Japan's geopolitical security risks had reached an all-time low, dropping to below 50%.

zh.s: 冲绳县于1994年11月20日举行知事选举。现任知事大田昌秀连任。1994年，日本内阁府开展的冲绳人态度调查发现，民众对日本地缘安全风险的担忧降至历史最低点，不到50%。

en.t: The Angolan government and UNITA rebels sign the Lusaka Protocol in Zambia, ending 19 years of civil war. (Localized fighting resumes the next year.)
en.s: The National Union for the Total Independence of Angola (Portuguese: União Nacional para a Independência Total de Angola, abbr. UNITA) is the second-largest political party in Angola. Founded in 1966, UNITA fought alongside the People's Movement for the Liberation of Angola (MPLA) and the National Liberation Front of Angola (FNLA) in the Angolan War for Independence (1961–1975) and then against the MPLA in the ensuing civil war (1975–2002).

zh.t: 安哥拉政府与安盟叛军在赞比亚签署《卢萨卡议定书》，结束19年内战（次年局部战斗再起）
zh.s: 安哥拉彻底独立全国联盟（葡萄牙语：União Nacional para a Independência Total de Angola，简称UNITA）是安哥拉第二大政党。该党成立于1966年，曾与安哥拉人民解放运动（MPLA）和安哥拉民族解放阵线（FNLA）并肩参加1961—1975年安哥拉独立战争，之后又在1975—2002年内战中与MPLA交战。

en.s: The 1996 Garley Building fire was a fire that took place on 20 November 1996 in the 16-storey Garley commercial building (Chinese: 嘉利大廈) located at 232–240 Nathan Road, Jordan, Hong Kong Kowloon West. It was a catastrophe that caused the loss of 41 lives and 81 injuries. It is considered the worst building fire in Hong Kong during peacetime. The fire damaged the bottom two floors and the top three floors of the building, while the middle floors remained relatively intact.

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Winchester was held on 20 November 1997 after its result at the general election the previous May was declared void. Mark Oaten of the Liberal Democrats won the seat with a wafer-thin majority of two votes over Conservative Gerry Malone earlier in the year, but following a legal challenge, a new election was allowed by the High Court.

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Beckenham was held on 20 November 1997, triggered by the resignation of the incumbent Conservative Party Member of Parliament (MP) Piers Merchant, who stood down following a scandal regarding his affair with a teenage bar hostess. zh.s: 在1999年5月首次举行威尔士议会选举前，威尔士自由民主党举行党内竞选，选出竞选负责人和未来议会党团领袖。竞选期间，该党领袖是布雷肯和拉德诺郡选区议员理查德·利夫西；他一直担任党领袖至2001年。

en.t: The beginning of the core of the ISS's tenure in orbit was the launch of the Russian-built Zarya module atop a Proton rocket on 20 November 1998
en.s: The International Space Station (ISS) is a space station in low Earth orbit (LEO). It is the product of the International Space Station program and is operated by five partner space agencies: NASA (United States), Roscosmos (Russia), ESA (Europe), JAXA (Japan), and CSA (Canada). It is the first space station built, maintained and crewed through international cooperation and the largest human spacecraft ever constructed.

zh.t: 国际空间站核心部分开始在轨运行：俄罗斯制造的曙光号舱段于1998年11月20日由质子号火箭发射
zh.s: 国际空间站（ISS）是运行于近地轨道的空间站，是国际空间站计划的成果，由五个合作机构运营：美国NASA、俄罗斯国家航天集团、欧洲航天局、日本宇宙航空研究开发机构和加拿大航天局。它是首个通过国际合作建造、维护并载人的空间站，也是人类建造过的最大航天器。

zh.s: 美国众议院阿肯色州第三国会选区特别选举于2001年11月20日举行，以选出阿萨·哈钦森的继任者。哈钦森获任缉毒局局长后辞去议员职务。

en.s: General elections were held in Jordan on 20 November 2007. en.s: The 2011 Spanish general election was held on Sunday, 20 November 2011, to elect the 10th Cortes Generales of the Kingdom of Spain. All 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies were up for election, as well as 208 of 266 seats in the Senate. The election was held amid the effects of a harsh financial crisis and José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero's government's perceived failure to cope with the worsening situation of the country's economy resulted in the ruling Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE) being swept from power in the worst defeat for a sitting Spanish government since 1982.

en.s: The Rochester and Strood by-election was a by-election for the UK parliamentary constituency of Rochester and Strood in Kent, England, held on 20 November 2014. The by-election was triggered when the sitting Conservative Member of Parliament (MP) Mark Reckless, left the Conservative Party and joined the UK Independence Party (UKIP). en.s: General elections were held in Equatorial Guinea on 20 November 2022 to elect the President and members of Parliament, alongside local elections. Originally the parliamentary elections had been scheduled for November 2022 and presidential elections for 2023. However, in September 2022 Parliament approved a proposal to merge the elections due to economic constraints. The government announced on 26 November 2022 that Obiang had won the election by an overwhelming margin, as expected.

en.s: General elections were held in Nepal on 20 November 2022 to elect the 275 members of the House of Representatives. There were two ballots in the election; one to elect 165 members from single-member constituencies via FPTP, and the other to elect the remaining 110 members from a single nation-wide constituency via party-list proportional representation. The election was held alongside provincial elections for the seven provincial assemblies.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Kazakhstan on 20 November 2022. This was the seventh presidential election since Kazakhstan's independence from the Soviet Union in 1991. Incumbent president Kassym-Jomart Tokayev, an independent, was re-elected for a second term in a landslide, receiving 81% of the vote. His closest challenger, Jiguli Dairabaev of the Auyl Party, received just 3% of the vote, marking the first time since 2015 that all candidates other than the incumbent president failed to garner 5% or more of the vote.

zh.s: 哈萨克斯坦于2022年11月20日举行总统选举，这是该国1991年脱离苏联独立以来的第七次总统选举。无党籍现任总统卡西姆若马尔特·托卡耶夫以81%的得票率大胜，连任第二个任期。最接近他的对手、奥伊尔党候选人吉古利·代拉巴耶夫仅获3%的选票。自2015年以来，这是首次所有非现任总统候选人的得票率都不到5%。

en.s: The 2022 FIFA World Cup was the 22nd FIFA World Cup, the quadrennial world championship for national football teams organised by FIFA. It took place in Qatar from 20 November to 18 December 2022, after the country was awarded the hosting rights in 2010. It was the first World Cup to be held in the Middle East and the Arabian Peninsula, and the second in an Asian country after the 2002 tournament in South Korea and Japan.
en.n: The 2022 FIFA World Cup begins in Qatar. This is the first time the tournament was held in the Middle East.

zh.n: 2022年国际足联世界杯在卡塔尔开幕。这是世界杯首次在中东举行。

en.s: General elections were held in Tonga on 20 November 2025. Prominent campaign issues included the cost of living and the monarchy's influence in government. ʻAisake Eke became prime minister in January 2025. He succeeded Siaosi Sovaleni, who served from 2021 until his resignation in December 2024, shortly before a planned no-confidence motion, which Eke introduced.
